narrativeProgression.description: Vanessa continues showing her YouTube channel on the tablet, emphasizing the absence of the upload button in its usual location.
She explicitly states that there is no upload button on the tablet version of the app.
Vanessa reveals the solution: the new upload button is located at the bottom of the screen, represented by a '+' icon.
She demonstrates clicking on the '+' icon and selecting the 'Video' option, leading to the video upload screen.
Vanessa explains this is the new way to upload videos on YouTube and criticizes YouTube for not announcing the change.
She shares her frustration in finding the solution, suggesting it wasn't easily accessible online.
Vanessa expresses gratitude to viewers and encourages them to subscribe to her channel.
She further requests viewers to like and share the video to help others.
She clarifies that the change might not be universal, as some YouTube channels still have the upload button at the top, including one of her own channels.
Vanessa reiterates the solution, emphasizing the new location of the upload button at the bottom of the screen.
She concludes the video with a final thank you and farewell.

trimmingSuggestions.description: The initial segment with fast cuts effectively grabs attention. However, the remaining scenes could be trimmed to improve pacing. Condensing Vanessa's explanations in scenes 2 and 3 would make the video more concise and focused on the solution.
The demonstration on the phone could be shortened, focusing on the key steps of showing the upload button's location.
